audit.why: Difficulty FAVOURED 4/10 matches a 49.27% win rate over 3895 games only loosely, but the lane pattern (magic damage into Galio's magic-damage reduction, no reliable disengage from Ahri before 6) supports Galio-favoured early. Row sides left untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] credited Galio with 'passive armor shred' (he has none) and used placeholder item phrasing 'Sunfire/Cinderhulk-esque bruiser starts'.
audit.why: Galio's passive in the kit file is bonus magic damage in an area with an auto-attack reset — no shred of any kind. Item names must be real.
audit.corrected: Named Hollow Radiance and Abyssal Mask, and stated the real limit: Orb of Deception's return hit is true damage, so MR does not blunt it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Charm 'instantly stops movement abilities', which cancels Galio's E dash and interrupts the W charge.
audit.why: Riot's own Charm text says it stops movement abilities. That is what makes Charm the timer the whole lane runs on, and nothing on the page said so.
audit.corrected: Charm (12s flat at every rank) stops your E and breaks your W charge; Orb's return is true damage; Essence Theft heals her every 9 minions.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Charm 12s flat, Orb 7s, Shield of Durand 18s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Rush was described only as 'a repositioning tool'; the three-charge structure was never given.
audit.why: Three dashes on one cooldown is why chasing her fails.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thirteen lint findings: eight misgenderings of a female enemy, two copy-paste bleeds, one no-digit cooldowns field.

edits.before: - Ahri Charm: matchup-defining — The charm starts every kill pattern — stay behind minions while it is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Shield of Durand for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Charm is a flat 12s at every rank — it starts every kill pattern, so stay behind minions while it is up and step up on its downtime. - Orb is 7s; W Shield of Durand is 18s at rank 1, so do not trade taunt for poke.

edits.before: Ahead, tax both maps: zone Ahri with taunt threat, keep the wave middle, and R every skirmish — fed Galio makes the enemy jungler unemployed.

edits.after: Carry by arriving: R shields the ally and knocks up around them, so land it on whoever she Spirit Rushes onto and she is stuck.

edits.before: Tank items (Sunfire/Cinderhulk-esque bruiser starts) make her Charm-Orb-Charm burst combo feel like tickles, and your passive armor shred keeps her squishy self in Q range.
edits.after: Hollow Radiance and Abyssal Mask blunt her Charm into Orb into Fox-Fire burst, but Orb's return hit is true damage and ignores that MR — bait the Charm rather than tanking the whole combo.

edits.before: You beat this lane by respecting Charm's range and never standing still in front of Orb of Deception; if she whiffs Charm, you have a full Q-E-P window to punish. W eats a huge chunk of her poke damage outright, so short-trade often and you win most exchanges by level 3.
edits.after: You beat this lane by respecting Charm's 975 range and never standing still in front of Orb of Deception — its return hit is true damage, so MR does not save you there. Charm is 12s: when she spends or whiffs it, you have a clean E-knockup into Q window to punish.
